song.title: I Am Peter
song.description: Une chanson simple pour apprendre à se présenter en anglais.
lyrics: I am, I am, I am Peter,
I am, I am, my name is Peter,
Nice to meet you, here I am.
A gentle voice, a name to share,
I am, I am, so calm, so clear,
My name is Peter, have no fear.
I am, I am, I am Peter,
I am, I am, my name is Peter,
Nice to meet you, here I am.
